name: Min-jun and Ji-ho Rosniak-Bishop
role: Gordan and Aimes's sons — twins, background presence only
description: Twins, eight years old, adopted from South Korea as infants and raised by Gordan and Aimes. Grouped as one entity for seeding purposes — background household presence establishing why the shack is Gordan's one private hour rather than a house he shares with no one. Not expected to carry individual dialogue or POV; use lightly (bedtime routine, a shared joke, a door closed on their noise) rather than as active plot participants.
daily_life: Elementary school; the ordinary noise and logistics of a full house.
